tasks.label: Save project files as zip
args:
import os, zipfile
base = r'${workspaceFolder}'
files = ['README.md', 'src/GameBoard.java', 'src/GameServices.java', 'src/PuzzleLogic.java', 'src/PuzzleLogicTest.java', 'src/SlidingPuzzle.java']
zip_path = os.path.join(base, 'SlidingPuzzleGame_saved.zip')
with zipfile.ZipFile(zip_path, 'w', compression=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as archive:
    for file in files:
        archive.write(os.path.join(base, file), arcname=file)
print('Created:', zip_path)
